_doc: M6-D/M6-D2 animation config. Read by game/anim_config.gd (viewer only, no
sim dependency, same load_config()-merges-over-a-default shape as
sim/highlights.gd) and threaded from game/main.gd into game/map_view.gd
(sheet layout) and used directly by game/main.gd itself (frame-advance
timing).
sheet.* describes the shared layout every character texture is read
against — sheet.rows is the pose order top-to-bottom, sheet.cols frames
of sheet.frame_px square pixels each per row. As of M6-D2 the roster's
'sprite_by_side' fields point at per-role LPC-derived sheets
(game/assets/characters/lpc_<role>_<blue|red>.png, tools/fetch_lpc_sprites.mjs)
at this exact layout; 'sprite' (unused while sprite_by_side is present)
still points at the older 24px procedural placeholder (tools/make_sprites.gd)
and would need a matching frame_px/rows override if it ever became the
live path again. game/main.gd's --selftest hard-asserts every anim_state
the game can ever assign has a real row here, so 'die' and 'recall' stay
rows even though the generator has no dedicated pose for either — both
reuse frames from an animation it does have (tools/fetch_lpc_sprites.mjs
has the exact columns); the separate recall ring VFX (map_view.gd) is
what actually reads as 'channeling', not the body pose underneath.
timing.frame_ticks: how many sim ticks (scaled by game/main.gd's own
_time_scale(), the same conversion every other playback transient uses)
one animation frame holds before advancing to the next column.
timing.die_ticks: how long a just-died body plays its die pose at the
spot it fell before handing off to the established fountain treatment
(game/map_view.gd _draw_dead). Both unmeasured 'feels right' placeholder
values (M6-D), same status as M6-B/C's zoom and director constants.
